description: This file defines a Visitor interface for traversing PolicyTreeNode objects within a tree structure, following the Visitor design pattern. It extends Supplier to provide access to accumulated data during traversal.

classes.name: Visitor
classes.description: A generic interface for visiting PolicyTreeNode objects, following the Visitor pattern. It extends Supplier to supply a result of type T after traversal.

methods.name: visitTreeNode
methods.description: Adds a PolicyTreeNode to the visitor for processing during traversal.
